# waldur Provider

Manage [Waldur](https://waldur.com/) resources with Terraform. Waldur is an open source platform for managing hybrid cloud infrastructure and running a service marketplace, and this provider drives its REST API, so anything the portal exposes can be described as code.

It covers organisational structure (customers, projects, users and role assignments), marketplace ordering and the resources those orders produce, and the OpenStack estate behind them -- tenants, networks, subnets, instances, volumes and security groups.

Configure it with the URL of your Waldur deployment and an API token, either inline or through the `WALDUR_API_URL` and `WALDUR_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variables. Tokens are issued from your user profile in the portal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    waldur = {
      source = "waldur/waldur"
    }
  }
}

# Option 1: Configure explicitly
provider "waldur" {
  endpoint = "https://waldur.example.com"
  token    = "your-api-token"
}

# Option 2: Use environment variables
# export WALDUR_API_URL="https://waldur.example.com"
# export WALDUR_ACCESS_TOKEN="your-api-token"
# 
# provider "waldur" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Waldur API endpoint URL. Can also be set via the `WALDUR_API_URL` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API authentication token. Can also be set via the `WALDUR_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable.
